longRun.interpretation: Frozen drift statistics pass, but the direct peer transport failed spontaneously about 1623 s into the window. The host recovered a fresh peer, Ready reset as designed and both players stayed paused for the last 177 samples. Both-playing, no-unexpected-recovery and no-unexpected-Ready-cycle steady-state conditions fail. No threshold changed, no rejected sample reclassified, no rerun.

findings.detail: The DIRECT Mac Wi-Fi to Android cellular IPv6 path failed spontaneously three times (first about 30 minutes after negotiation) while signaling and Android cellular stayed up. Cause not identified.
The per-membership negotiation budget (4) was exhausted by spontaneous recoveries, consistent with the host stopping recovery at its bound immediately after the later genuine loss.

findings.kind: PRODUCT (known Phase 2C limitation, now observed on a real mobile network)
findings.detail: After restoration the guest resume was refused while the service still held the dead socket; the finite resume schedule ended the membership before liveness timeout.

First room abandoned before media: Chrome was backgrounded on the phone and the guest left. A non-fixture personal video was picked once outside any room and cleared before any room; nothing about it was transmitted or recorded.
